game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: crispybagel
quote: Amazing game, with plenty of challenge and one of the best stories I've come across in a while, from an amazing studio that shows appreciation to their fans. I wish more studios operated this way and listened to what their fans actually wanted. Can't wait for their next game, I'll be there day one!

author: crispybagel
quote: Part one was definitely better. Gameplay wasnt terrible, but the story is absolute dogs*** and ruined what part one had going for it. I recommend you wait until the dust settles on anything this studio releases going forward.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: crispybagel
quote: This game is a giant disappointment. The graphics are good, and that's about where the good ends for this game. The story pacing is garbage, and lacks any real substance. The driving is absolute s*** and feels terrible. The morality system is outdated and lame. The main characters are boring and the main contributors to what makes this the most souless entry we've seen in GTA franchise history. Will never be buying a Rockstar game on launch ever again. Save your money and skip this one.
